title: Chicken Tagine
description: A classic French dish inspired by Algerian flavors, made with tender chicken and aromatic spices.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add the garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 2-3 minutes.
3. Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, 5-7 minutes.
4. Add the Algerian spice mix, salt, and black pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute.
5. Add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
6. Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer to the oven. Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
7. Stir in the apricots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
8. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
9. Serve with couscous or rice, if desired.
10. Let the tagine rest for 5 minutes before serving.
